verdict.rationale: iTerm2 natively divides a tab into multiple panes, sliced vertically and horizontally, each running its own session (iterm2-docs-1, iterm2-docs-25). It organizes work in a window/tab/pane hierarchy with Open Quickly and Global Search across tabs (iterm2-gh-16, iterm2-gh-5, iterm2-docs-18). Long-lived session servers keep shells alive across crashes or upgrades, giving persistence without tmux (iterm2-gh-4), and tmux integration is optional (iterm2-docs-23). Missing for 10: in-depth docs on pane navigation, resizing and layout management; independent or hands-on corroboration of the pane/tab workflow.
